about: Plan and execute the perfect heist in a fully destructible world. In Teardown, anything can be broken, moved, or turned into a shortcut.
Take your time and use creative problem-solving, brute force, and everything around you to create an efficient path through the level.

Run, jump, drive, slingshot. Do whatever you need to collect targets, avoid robots, or steal whatever your clients ask for, alone or together with friends in multiplayer. And whatever you do… don’t get caught.

Features Fully destructible voxel environments Realistic physics, fire, smoke, water, debris, and vehicles Multiplayer chaos - up to 12 people Huge arsenal of tools and explosives Story-driven campaign with 40 missions, fun in single player, a…
Sandbox mode for unlimited resources and destruction, alone or together with friends Over 100 community created mods available in free DLC Mod Packs.
Campaign After accepting a shady offer in hopes of saving your demolition business, you’re pulled into a murky soup of revenge, betrayal, and insurance fraud.
summary: Prepare the perfect heist in this simulated and fully destructible voxel world.
